reviews.comment: I couldn't follow her teaching style. Would have learned more from going through the slides myself and teaching myself. Cheat sheets on exams. 3 midterms. No final. Does not annotate her slides, writes on a small whiteboard then erases it immediately. Practice exams are only somewhat like the real exam. You benefit from learning on your own.

Attendence is not mandatory but would recommend going as she explains a lot about the powerpoints and without that they can be hard to understand on your own. Homeworks are not too difficult or long. Tests are very fair and reflect the material taught in class i.e. no surprises on the tests if you study the materials given. Good stats proffessor.

She's a nice professor if you put in your work and be ready to improve. She really takes in the feedback and try to make the experience better for everyone. This class is very test-heavy, but the tests are not hard at all, and the materials is pretty interesting
